motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Opacity .5, translate(-50%,-48%), scale(.985) to centered rest.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, animations and transitions use .01ms, one animation iteration, and scroll-behavior:auto.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size:12px; min-height:33px; padding:6px 13px; border:0; border-radius:7px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms,transform 180ms var(--ease),box-shadow 150ms; color:var(--surface); background:var(--accent); }.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--accent-hover); }.ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }.ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity:.48; cursor:default; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

components.css: .ds-button-secondary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size:12px; min-height:33px; padding:6px 13px; border:0; border-radius:7px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms,transform 180ms var(--ease),box-shadow 150ms; color:var(--text); background:var(--inset); }.ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--hover); }.ds-button-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }.ds-button-secondary:disabled { opacity:.48; cursor:default; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

components.name: Text field
components.html: <input class="ds-field" aria-label="Repository URL" placeholder="Paste a GitHub link">
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size:12px; color:var(--text); background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; padding:8px 10px; caret-color:var(--accent); } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--tertiary); opacity:1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size:13px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; border:0; height:39px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:8px; background:var(--sidebar-selected); color:var(--accent); font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms,color 160ms; } .ds-nav:hover { background:var(--sidebar-selected); color:var(--accent); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-nav { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

components.name: Settings switch
components.description: Native-like boolean preference with a visible label.
components.html: <label class="ds-switch-label">Check for updates<input class="ds-switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked></label>
components.css: .ds-switch-label { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:22px; color:var(--text); } .ds-switch { appearance:none; width:34px; height:20px; padding:0; margin:0; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:var(--hover); position:relative; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms var(--ease); } .ds-switch::before { content:""; position:absolute; width:16px; height:16px; left:2px; top:2px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0003; transition:transform 180ms var(--spring); } .ds-switch:checked { background:var(--accent); } .ds-switch:checked::before { transform:translateX(14px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-switch:disabled { opacity:.48; cursor:default; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-switch,.ds-switch::before { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

components.name: Storage summary
components.description: Inset content grouping without floating-layer elevation.
components.css: .ds-storage { font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; padding:26px; background:var(--inset); border-radius:12px; color:var(--text); } .ds-storage strong { display:block; font-size:24px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.03em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-storage span { font-size:11px; color:var(--secondary); }

components.name: App identity row
components.description: Separated library row with a deterministic monogram and accessible detail action.
components.css: .ds-row { display:flex; min-height:105px; align-items:center; padding:18px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); } .ds-identity { font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; display:flex; gap:17px; align-items:center; text-align:left; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:none; padding:0; color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; } .ds-identity strong { display:block; font-size:15px; font-weight:620; letter-spacing:-.015em; } .ds-identity small { display:block; margin-top:4px; color:var(--secondary); font-size:11px; } .ds-monogram { width:54px; height:54px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:13px; background:hsl(210,34%,90%); color:hsl(210,42%,30%); font-size:25px; font-weight:550; letter-spacing:-.04em; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff80,inset 0 -1px 0 #00000008; } .ds-identity:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Relay uses the familiar structure of a native desktop library. System typography, cool neutral surfaces, blue actions, and separated app rows keep names and actions easy to scan. The sidebar has an opaque neutral fill that suggests native material without blur.

The interface follows system appearance by default and also supports explicit light and dark choices. Motion explains temporary layers and operation state. App identities use deterministic monograms and Lucide line icons. The geometric desktop icon is authored SVG, with generated desktop icon provenance in `src-tauri/icons/PROVENANCE.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Short layer transitions with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: Semantic appearance
rules.body: Use the semantic CSS variables so text, actions, and surfaces change together between light and dark.

rules.name: Native type
rules.body: Use the system font stack for application headings, controls, and copy. Keep monospaced text for actual code or paths that need it.

rules.name: Layer depth
rules.body: Keep the main library flat. Reserve broad shadows for menus, dialogs, notices, and the details panel.

dos: Do use semantic theme variables and preserve the system appearance default.
Do preserve labelled keyboard controls, visible focus, live operation status, and reduced-motion support.
Do use the existing Lucide stroke icons and deterministic app monograms.
Do keep repository names, paths, and failures readable through wrapping, truncation with detail access, or scrolling.
donts: Don't add decorative blur, invented app imagery, or card grids to the native row system.
Don't use color alone to communicate an error, update, or operation state.
Don't replace contextual lifecycle actions with permanent controls on every row.
